The product, step by step

What a member sees at /runs/live

Every chart below is a live WebGL2 render (verified webgl2:true, not a Canvas fallback), streaming over a ticketed WebSocket. Captured against the running app.

sooppiy · /runs/live
01

The multi-run grid WebGL2 · live WS

Small multiples, one per run. Each tile carries a live equity sparkline, a color-coded status badge — ARMED (waiting on a start condition), DRAFT, RUNNING — and a data-age badge (⧗ 51s) that stays honest about polled-market latency.

sooppiy · /runs/live · new run
02

Run settings — exactly Henry's four requirements

Max bet, target symbol, spot/futures (futures gated to crypto), interval, min-confidence, and stop events (stop-loss / profit-target in USD) — plus report cadence and per-trade alerts. Malformed conditions are rejected server-side; futures forces crypto; leverage is pinned to 1 in v1.

sooppiy · /runs/live · BTC detail
03

Run detail — the terminal view event journal

A larger WebGL2 equity curve, live P&L, and lifecycle controls (Pause · Stop&flatten · Stop&hold). Below, the run's own event journal streams every equity tick, decision, and trade — the same append-only log the server treats as source of truth.

sooppiy · /runs/live · light
04

Theme-aware & localized

The same board in the light theme — card grounds, ink, and hairlines all flip through CSS variables while WebGL2 stays active. The whole page is localized across five languages (ko / en / ja / th / vi); shown here in Korean.

https://sooppiy.com
05

Live in production members-only

sooppiy.com serving the new build. The members-only paywall gates the app — the four plan tiers here (Junior / Pro / Professional / Enterprise) are the exact keys the new server-side entitlement gate reads.

How it was designed

A 16-agent pipeline hardened the plan before a line shipped
Nine phases, each with its own verification gate
0Prod env audit — creds, Redis, price feed, alembic on the real box✓ RECORDED
1Schema + lifecycle — state machine, active_key exclusivity, run_events✓ 20 tests
2Scheduler — lease + fencing → exactly-once trades across crashes✓ 13 tests
3Risk + stops — fail-closed on stale marks, flatten, short bankruptcy✓ 14 tests
4Reporting — digests + thresholds, journal-before-send with retry✓ 11 tests
5Entitlements — gate both engines, agent-lifecycle cascade✓ 11 tests
6Streaming — ticketed /ws/runs with per-sub authorization✓ 10 tests
7·8WebGL2 + UI — chart kernel, /runs/live dashboard, 5 langs, 3 themes✓ browser-verified
9Dark prod rollout — merged, deployed, migrated, verified on sooppiy.com◐ DEPLOYED DARK

What review caught

Findings by review lens — every one fixed before shipping
blocker · 3 major · 26 minor · 38

The three blockers were the ones that matter: an entitlement bypass through the old automation API, a cross-tenant P&L leak in the WebSocket, and an exactly-once hole in crash recovery. All closed and regression-tested before the first commit.

Deploy verification

Shipped to sooppiy.com — and proven, not assumed
✓Migration applied — alembic current == 0022 (head); trading_runs / run_events / run_reports live on prod MySQL.
✓Containers healthy — backend + worker on 20260719-plan10, stable, no crashes.
✓New loops dark — trading_runs / run_reports / subscription_enforcer start & no-op; flags confirmed off in-container.
✓SPA republished — new bundle to nginx + restorecon; public root 200; Plan-10 strings present in the served chunk.
✓WebSocket real — /ws/runs returns 403 on a bogus ticket through the full nginx→uvicorn path (not the SPA-fallback 200 lie).
✓Rollback ready — app.prev-20260719-plan10, prior SPA, and image 20260718-2228 all retained.

The one remaining step is yours

The feature is live but inert — activation is a deliberate, flag-gated decision

Both flags default off, so no run executes yet. To go live:

  1. Provide the real PLAN_LIMITS numbers (per-tier concurrent-run caps, max-bet caps, daily analysis budgets) → set ENTITLEMENTS_ENFORCED=true. SMS is already enabled on all paid tiers, per your call.
  2. Flip AUTO_TRADING_ENABLED=true for one admin-owned agent first; verify a real digest email + threshold SMS end-to-end.
  3. Roll out per tier.
한국어 — AI 자동매매 "런" 기능이 sooppiy.com에 다크(dark) 배포되었습니다. 16-에이전트 파이프라인으로 설계·검증(발견 67건 전부 반영), 9개 페이즈 구현, 백엔드 테스트 1304개 통과(회귀 0). 위 스크린샷은 실제 실행 중인 앱을 캡처한 것입니다 — 멀티런 그리드(WebGL2 실시간 차트), 런 생성 폼, 런 상세(이벤트 저널), 라이트 테마, 프로덕션 페이지. 현재 두 플래그가 꺼져 있어 실제 매매는 아직 실행되지 않습니다. 활성화하려면: (1) 실제 PLAN_LIMITS 수치 → ENTITLEMENTS_ENFORCED=true, (2) 관리자 에이전트 1개로 AUTO_TRADING_ENABLED=true 검증, (3) 등급별 순차 롤아웃.
